difficulty_reason: H2: the author compares lifts attached to potentially distant compatible building facets, subdivides their fixed-point segment, and checks through root-value data that every intermediate facet retains the prescribed Levi and projected facet. After reducing to adjacent facets, the proof identifies two parabolic spaces in one finite reductive quotient with the same Levi, and compares the lifts via a common induced function and its exact nonzero cardinality factor. This source-local geometric and finite-group comparison supplies the independence of the class in I(G), rather than assuming it from the existing cuspidal orbital-pairing formula.
